added_software_latency_assertion.scope: Per-message measured total minus one-sample simulated-clock replay of the selected message stream, available at original source times; includes added batching, queueing, CPU and OS scheduling. Intrinsic serialization, modem/FEC and startup remain in the separately reported reference. No physical audio device.

observations.host_added_latency_scope: Per-message measured total minus one-sample simulated-clock replay of the selected message stream, available at original source times; includes added batching, queueing, CPU and OS scheduling. Intrinsic serialization, modem/FEC and startup remain in the separately reported reference. No physical audio device.
observations.host_stage_scope: Stage times are wall time per call; they are not additive per-message latency attribution. TX/RX include internal FEC/crypto/framing; queue residence stays in end-to-end latency.
observations.host_timing_scope: Paced simulated audio loopback, source creation through real auction/framing/FEC/crypto/modem to sink; OS scheduling included; no physical audio device, network socket, or radio.

parameters.aead_context: fixed domain/version, fiber-negotiated epoch and sequence mode, implicit ciphertext length
parameters.aead_epoch_policy: Fresh isolated TEST journal per probe; production journals persist across restarts
parameters.aead_nonce: big-endian uint64 durable epoch || uint32 frame sequence starting at 1
parameters.agc_envelope: linear dB attack to requested step; 50 ms hold; linear dB decay to baseline
parameters.audio_filter: 129-tap Hamming-window FIR + two first-order edge allpasses
parameters.audio_jitter_model: Seeded block delay begins at audio_event_s; monotonic arrivals; production deadline check rejects arrivals beyond declared playout slack

cadence_plan.scope: Nominal complete segment including RRC tails, acquisition, training, header, pilots and equalizer flush; no CPU or propagation time

parameters.cochannel_key: Independent test key: first byte 0xa8, remaining 31 zero bytes; same key ID and RF profile
parameters.crypto: OpenSSL AES-256-GCM before FEC; 128-bit tag; COBS record delimiter
parameters.crypto_scope: Production message records; raw RF symbol/coding screens exclude encryption
parameters.doppler_definition: 2*sigma of Gaussian power spectrum; zero path carrier shifts

equalizer.pilot_gain_trigger: power excursion; recursive tracking remains active until gain returns within 5% of baseline
equalizer.recursive_phase_scope: feedforward signal only; feedback decisions remain in the corrected constellation
equalizer.support_candidate_estimator: shadow NLMS on inactive coefficients; active RLS coefficients retained
equalizer.uncertainty_clock: every observed symbol; capped at existing covariance bound

parameters.gaussian_fading_filter: 129 taps at 32*spread Hz; stationary initialized history; linear audio interpolation
parameters.impulse_arrivals: periodic at declared rate; Gaussian burst RMS relative to Gaussian floor
parameters.papr_scope: finite clean pulse-shaped RF waveform, including acquisition, training, headers, pilots and tails; no PA model or power increase assumed

recovery_training.cold_fallback: same received block on failed warm training
recovery_training.startup: varied known payload symbols from training sequence

parameters.rf_payload_budget: requested audio seconds times complete-waveform payload duty; finite payload completed including partial-segment startup/tail
parameters.scheduler_policy: One replaceable bid until framer claim; newer same-key market update supersedes regardless of bid; highest bid per wire byte, newest on ties; no age boost
parameters.seed_policy: mt19937 Box-Muller; independent XOR-derived stage seeds; counter-based payload
parameters.snr_definition: nominal unit-mean-constellation complex-sample signal/noise power before fading; not 3 kHz SNR or Eb/N0

soft_metric_parameters.decoder_output: Viterbi hard decisions; production message integrity checked by AES-256-GCM

parameters.source_event_clock: Integral sample periods derived from event index; variable overload periods accumulated; source tick misses checked for aligned B5 events
parameters.source_revision_note: git_commit is the base revision; source_tree_sha256 identifies the tested working-tree snapshot
parameters.waveform: Goblin Cannon single_carrier; not a certified Appendix D waveform
